claims.explanation: SB-205384 is a positive allosteric modulator of GABAA receptors containing α3, α5, or α6 subunits, and its selective killing likely depends on expression of these subunits in cancer cells. The transcriptional response resembles glucocorticoid receptor activation, suggesting that GABAA modulation may intersect with steroid receptor signaling, but the most direct genomic predictors are expression of GABRA3, GABRA5, and GABRA6. Lines with high expression of these subunits are expected to be sensitized, while those with low expression are protected.

features.basis: SB-205384 potentiates α3-containing GABAA receptors (PMID 23902941)
SB-205384 potentiates α5-containing GABAA receptors (PMID 23902941)
SB-205384 potentiates α6-containing GABAA receptors (PMID 23902941)
GABAA receptors require β subunits; β3 coexpression enhances α3/α5/α6 modulation (PMID 23902941)
γ2 subunit is part of the recombinant receptor combination potentiated by SB-205384 (PMID 23902941)
TP53 mutations are common in both sensitive and resistant lines, but many resistant lines have TP53 mutations, suggesting intact p53 may enhance sensitivity
PTEN mutations appear in several sensitive lines (ZR751, HEC265, KALS1, FTC133, UACC62) but also in resistant lines, weak evidence
BRAF mutations are present in several resistant melanoma lines (K029AX, IGR37, UACC62) and some sensitive lines, weak evidence
KRAS mutations appear in several sensitive lines (KPNSI9S, CL11, T3M4) but also in resistant lines, weak evidence
EGFR mutations are present in resistant lines (HCC4006, KYSE270) and some sensitive lines, weak evidence
